symbols.name: ZeroColumns
symbols.description:
Set an explicit replication column allowlist instead of Eloquent's $visible.

Eloquent's $hidden and ZeroExclude still remove columns. ZeroIncludeColumns
can restore excluded columns but cannot expand this allowlist.

symbols.name: ZeroExclude
symbols.description:
Exclude database columns in addition to Eloquent's $hidden.

Applies within the $visible or ZeroColumns allowlist. ZeroIncludeColumns
can explicitly opt an excluded column back in.

symbols.name: ZeroIncludeColumns
symbols.description:
Opt database columns back in despite $visible, $hidden, or ZeroExclude.

An explicit ZeroColumns allowlist remains the upper bound on replication.
